in_marathi.name: Brijlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of pastures, joyful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brijlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brij means pasture and Lal means joyful or lord. The name is derived from Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the Lord of the Pastures. Brijlal is a name that embodies joy, peace, and abundance.
